an3.105:1.1: No ce taṃ bhikkhave loke assādo abhavissa na-y-idaṃ sattā loke sārajjeyyuṃ, yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi loke assādo tasmā sattā loke sārajjanti. No ce taṃ bhikkhave loke ādīnavo abhavissa na-y-idaṃ sattā loke nibbindeyyuṃ, yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi loke ādīnavo tasmā sattā loke nibbindanti. No ce taṃ bhikkhave lokamhā nissaraṇaṃ abhavissa na-y-idaṃ sattā loke nissareyyuṃ, yasmā ca kho bhikkhave atthi loke nissaraṇaṃ tasmā sattā lokamhā nissaranti. Yāvakīvañ ca bhikkhave sattā lokassa assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ na abhaññāsuṃ n' eva tāva bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā samārakā sabrahmakā sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā vihariṃsu. Yato ca kho bhikkhave sattā lokassa assādañ ca assādato ādīnavañ ca ādīnavato nissaraṇañ ca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsuṃ atha bhikkhave sattā sadevakā lokā . . . nissaṭā visaṃyuttā vippamuttā vimariyādikatena cetasā viharantī ti. Ye
